intentions: Define and manage category entities with unique names and optional reorder thresholds
Define and manage product entities with unique SKUs, foreign key to category, price in cents, stock quantity, and low-active flag
Implement a SQLite-based CategoryRepository with CRUD operations and ability to find all products in a category
Implement a SQLite-based ProductRepository with CRUD operations, filtering by category, identifying low-stock items, and aggregating stock value by category
Develop an InventoryService with business logic for product and category operations including validation, updates, deletions, and reporting
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested command groups for product and category management
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point inaccuracies
Use auto-incremented primary keys for IDs that are optional in domain models
Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite to maintain referential integrity
Implement custom exception classes for CategoryNotFoundError and ProductNotFoundError
Provide comprehensive error handling across all operations
Support filtering and querying capabilities in the CLI for products and categories
Enable reporting features for low-stock items and category-level stock value
